text:
The plate is a square, roughly 22 cm per side, so I treated it as a side-to-dinner-size plate.

**Egg whites:** They cover about 30% of the plate, roughly 150 cm², and are about 2.5 cm high. That is about 375 cm³, and with fluffy air pockets I counted about 0.6 of that as solid. This gives about 220 g. Scrambled egg whites run about 55 kcal per 100 g.

**Roasted potatoes:** They cover about 8% of the plate, roughly 40 cm², and are about 2 cm high. That is about 80 cm³, and at about 0.7 solid and 0.8 g/cm³ density I estimated about 60 g. They look pan-fried or roasted, so I used about 150 kcal per 100 g.
